name: IDEA Sensen Fukoku Hen
source:
"I'll, I'll definitely never do as you want. I will kill you without fail!"

One day a normal high school girl "Hoshisaki Mirai" is summoned to a warped fantasy world. 
Mirai gains the cooperation of the inhabitants in order to find a way to return home.
But due to the efforts of a strange witch she gets wrapped up in a ruinous fate.

[Translated from the official site]
translation:
“我、我绝对不会按你说的做。我一定会杀了你！”

某天，普通高中女生星崎未来被召唤到扭曲的幻想世界。
为了寻找回家的方法，未来获得了当地居民的协助。
然而，在一名奇怪女巫的推动下，她被卷入了毁灭性的命运。

[译自官方网站]
